name: Love Sucks
source:
A visual novel about the vampire stonemason Gottfried Steinmetz who is haunted by the memory of Count Dracula.

Play as Gottfried as he recounts the fateful night that changed him forever 200 years ago.

[From [url=https://cubiecat.itch.io/love-sucks]Itch.io[/url]]
